name: huawei-github
description: Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, PRs, actions, and more via the official GitHub MCP server (api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/). Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint — install-free (pure-stdlib wrapper), but requires a GitHub Personal Access Token. This is the first EXTERNAL-host MCP tool in this repo: unlike the Huawei intranet tools (which bypass the corporate proxy), GitHub must go THROUGH the corporate proxy. Usable by any MCP-capable agent (load the bundled config) or any agent with Bash + Python 3 (run the bundled wrapper script).

network.note: This is an EXTERNAL host (not Huawei intranet). It MUST go through the corporate proxy, unlike the other mcp-tools which bypass it. The wrapper sets ProxyHandler to route through proxyuk.huawei.com:8080. The proxy does TLS interception; the wrapper disables cert verification (ssl.CERT_NONE) as the equivalent of curl's --ssl-no-revoke. When loading the MCP config into an agent, the agent's MCP client must also route through the proxy (set HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxyuk.huawei.com:8080 in the shell that launches the agent).

auth_detail: GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT). Set GITHUB_MCP_PAT in the environment (wrapper reads it) or Authorization: Bearer <token> in headers (config). Generate at github.com/settings/tokens (repo scope minimum).
